summary.text: Lori Rogich is a Republican member of the Nevada Senate, representing District 11 in Clark County. She was first elected in November 2024, and the legislature lists her as an attorney and owner of Rogich Law Firm PLLC.

paragraphs.text: The Nevada Legislature says Rogich was born in Union, New Jersey, in 1965 and earned a B.A. in history from Rutgers University, where she was elected to Phi Beta Kappa, and a J.D. from Rutgers Law School.
She is admitted to the State Bar of Nevada and the U.S. District Court for the District of Nevada.
Her page describes her as an advocate for children with special needs and says Rogich vs. Clark County School District produced a landmark federal court ruling in special education law.
She serves on the Senate Jobs and Economy Committee.
